info.title: Foundation Platform staff data catalog API
info.description: Find data and read its description, columns and one step of lineage either way (root ADR-0117, ADR-0119); see how the scheduled jobs ran and what the data contracts' checks found (root ADR-0165).

get.summary: A dataset's Iceberg snapshots, newest first, with the run that made each and what read it.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.description: The dataset's pipeline-graph node, as a scheduled job's `reads` or `writes` names it.

403.description: Principal may not read the data catalog

500.description: The job list could not be read

get.summary: Reads one entity with its columns and one step of lineage either way.

parameters.name: urn

403.description: Principal may not read the data catalog

503.description: The data catalog is not configured or not reachable

403.description: Principal may not read the data catalog

get.summary: Finds datasets by name or description.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find in names and descriptions; `*` or empty lists everything.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based offset of the first result.

403.description: Principal may not read the data catalog

503.description: The data catalog is not configured or not reachable

ApiErrorResponse.description: Safe error body returned by Foundation API handlers.

DataCatalogEntity.description: One entity as a list, a search result or a graph node shows it.

description.description: What it is, in the words its owner wrote.

name.description: The name people know it by.

platform.description: The system it lives in, when the catalog records one.

urn.description: The catalog's identifier; pass it back unchanged to read the entity or its neighbours.

DataCatalogEntityKind.description: What kind of thing a catalog entity is.

native_type.description: Type as the catalog records it.

DataCatalogNeighbourhood.description:
An entity and the entities one step before and after it.

A dataset's neighbours are the jobs that write and read it; a job's neighbours are the datasets
it reads and writes. A screen walks the graph by asking for a neighbour's neighbours.

fields.description: Its columns, for a dataset whose schema the catalog holds.

results.description: Results on this page, best match first.

start.description: Zero-based offset of the first result on this page.

total.description: Entities the query matches in total, not just on this page.

DataContractQuality.description: One data contract and the latest result of each of its checks.

contract_id.description: The contract's id (the dataset it promises).

dataset_urn.description: The contract's entity in the data catalog.

DataQualityCheck.description: One check a data contract defines and its latest result.

assertion_urn.description: The check's identifier in the data catalog.

details.description: What the job reported with it (counts, missing columns), as it wrote them.

field.description: The column it checks, for a column check.

kind.description: The catalog's kind for it (for example `FIELD` or `DATA_SCHEMA`), as the catalog names it.

DataQualityDetail.description: One key and value the quality job reported with a result.

key.description: The key, as the job wrote it.

value.description: The value, as the job wrote it.

DataQualityResult.description: The latest result of a data-quality check.

DataQualityStatus.description: Every data contract the data catalog holds, with its checks' latest results.

DatasetSnapshot.description: One `main` snapshot of an Iceberg table.

ingested_objects.description: The source objects the commit recorded as loaded (`foundation.ingest-batch-objects`).

job_id.description: The scheduled job whose run was going when it was committed.

read_by.description: The snapshots of other tables built from it.

read_from.description: The input snapshots it was built from (`foundation.source-iceberg-snapshots`).

run_urn.description: That run, in the data catalog.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot's id, as text (it does not fit a JSON number).

total_records.description: Rows the table held after it.

DatasetSnapshotLink.description: One table snapshot another snapshot read or was read by.

committed_at.description: When it was committed, when the table's metadata still holds it.

node_id.description: The table's pipeline-graph node, when a scheduled job reads or writes it.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot's id, as text (it does not fit a JSON number).

DatasetSnapshots.description: A dataset's Iceberg snapshots, newest first.

error.description: Why the snapshots could not be read, when they could not.

snapshots.description: Its `main` snapshots the metadata still holds, newest first.

table.description: Its Iceberg table, when it is one.

FailureCause.description: What a failed run's log says broke it.

InternalApiErrorResponse.description: Opaque internal-error body returned by Foundation API handlers.

correlation_id.description: Opaque identifier operators can use to locate an internal failure.

OperationsLinks.description: Where staff open the scheduler's and the data catalog's own screens, when configured.

ScheduledJobDataset.description:
One dataset a scheduled job reads or writes: an endpoint of a pipeline-graph edge the job
carries out.

catalog_urn.description: Its entity in the data catalog (`GET /data-catalog/v1/entity?urn=`).

dataset.description: The dataset as the scheduler and the data catalog name it (`<platform>://<name>`).

kind.description:
The node's kind there (for example `source_group`, `silver_table`, `gold_table`,
`serving_surface`), as the pipeline graph names it.

node_id.description: Its node in the pipeline graph (`GET /catalog/v1/pipeline-graph`).

surface_kind.description: For a serving surface, what kind (for example `tiles` or `r2_baked_documents`).

title.description: The node's title there, in Korean.

oneOf.description: The cause, classified from the run's log; absent when the log could not be read.

cause_line.description: The line of the log that says it, with credentials masked.

scheduler_run_id.description: The scheduler's id of the failed run, for its log.

oneOf.description: A job it waits on failed or is itself blocked, so its inputs will not come.

upstream_job_ids.description: The jobs it waits on that failed or are blocked, in job-list order.

oneOf.description:
Its schedule started it at `due_at` and gave it its time limit, and no run has succeeded
since.

due_at.description: The scheduled start a success is missing for.

last_success_at.description: When it last succeeded, among the runs the catalog holds.

oneOf.description: Its latest run took, or is taking, much longer than it usually does.

seconds.description: How long it took, or has run so far.

oneOf.description: Its latest run wrote far fewer or far more rows to a table than its recent runs did.

rows.description: Rows the latest run added to it.

typical_rows.description: The median of what the recent runs before it added.

oneOf.description: Its latest run ended waiting for something it named, not failed (root ADR-0260).

reason.description: What it waits for, as its run said; absent when the log could not be read.

scheduler_run_id.description: The scheduler's id of that run, for its log.

ScheduledJobProblem.description: Something about a scheduled job a person should look at (root ADR-0195).

ScheduledJobRun.description: One run of a scheduled job that the data catalog holds.

finished_at.description: When the run completed; absent while it runs.

native_result.description: The scheduler's own word for the result, as it sent it, when it sent one.

rows_written.description:
Rows the run added to the Iceberg tables it writes: the `added-records` of the `main`
snapshots committed to them while it ran. Absent while it runs, for a job that writes no
Iceberg table, and when the lakehouse catalog could not be read.

run_urn.description: The run's identifier in the data catalog.

started_at.description: When the run started, from its first recorded start.

ScheduledJobRunOutcome.description:
How a scheduled job's run stands, in the run record the scheduler sent to the data catalog
(`OpenLineage`, root ADR-0118 §2): started and not yet complete, or complete with a result.

ScheduledJobStart.description: What starts a scheduled job (the job list's `started_by`, root ADR-0171).

ScheduledJobStatus.description: One scheduled job: what the job list says about it and its latest run.

catalog_job_urn.description: The job's entity in the data catalog that holds the latest run, once a run reported.

dag_id.description: The scheduler's name for the job (its Airflow DAG).

description.description: What the job does, as the job list says.

disabled_reason.description: Why it is off and what turns it on, for a job that is off.

job_id.description: The job's id in the job list (`orchestration/jobs.v1.json`).

oneOf.description: Its latest run the data catalog holds; absent before the first.

next_run_at.description: The next time its schedule starts it; absent for a job that is off.

pipeline_graph_edges.description:
The pipeline-graph edges it carries out, as the job list names them; empty for a job that
only checks the data-contract tables.

problems.description: What about it a person should look at, worst first; empty when it is fine (root ADR-0195).

recent_runs.description:
The recent runs of the catalog job of `last_run`, newest first, at most ten; `last_run` is
the first.

schedule.description: When it runs: the job list's cron schedule, in UTC.

typical_duration_runs.description: How many succeeded runs `typical_duration_seconds` is the median of; 0 when it is absent.

typical_duration_seconds.description:
How long the job usually takes, in whole seconds: the median of `finished_at - started_at`
over the recent succeeded runs the data catalog holds for the catalog job of `last_run`.
Absent when none of those runs succeeded with both times recorded.

upstream_job_ids.description:
The other jobs that write one of the datasets it reads, in job-list order: the jobs it waits
on (root ADR-0171, ADR-0188).

ScheduledJobsStatus.description: Every scheduled job and its latest run.

jobs.description: Every job in the job list, in its order.

lakehouse_error.description:
Why the tables' snapshots could not be read, when the lakehouse catalog did not answer or
is not configured: no run then has `rows_written` and no job a volume problem.

links.description: Where the scheduler's and the catalog's own screens are.

run_history_error.description:
Why the runs could not be read, when the data catalog did not answer. The jobs are still
listed, and then no job's missing run means it never ran.

scheduler_error.description:
Why failed runs' logs could not be read, when the scheduler did not answer or is not
configured: a failed problem then has no cause.
